text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Merry Christmas, y'all!

Today is Christmas. As a token of appreciation
for all our hard work so far, I was having
a Christmas party with Yukino Bijin.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I was really surprised.
To have such awesome decorations put up for me."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"The tinsel hanging on the wall, the tree...
Trainer, did you do all of this by yourself?"
choice_data_list: I was hoping it would make Yukino happy.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course!
I'm so freakin' happy~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: This brings back memories of the parties we used to have at home.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The moment I stepped into the room,
I felt this incredibly warm and fuzzy feeling.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I don't think it really makes up for anything,
buuut...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I tried my hand at cooking!
My mom taught me how to make
local Morioka dishes over the phone!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I ain't good at cookin', so to be honest
I was plannin' on buyin' prepared food, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Mom's cooking really is the best. So I thought I might as well give it a try myself!"
choice_data_list: Thanks, I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, please go easy on me
with your evaluation.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I left 'em out in the hallway,
so I'll go grab 'em real quick!
(Rattle-clatter-clatter...)

"No, I can't... This is someone else's food.
Someone else's food... Someone else's..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wh-wh-what?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —I am truly, deeply sorry...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"No way~! Oguri-san,
you were just staring at the food the whole time, weren't ya?"
Startled by Yukino Bijin's voice, I rushed over, and there in the hallway was—Oguri Cap.
An idol Umamusume from the countryside who could be said to have started the Yukino Bijin boom...

She was, in a sense, a pioneer who walked the path
Yukino Bijin now treads. Whenever she was on the verge of faltering,
she too would picture Oguri Cap in her mind.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—You were screaming.
And in a voice I'd never heard from you before...
I must have terrified you.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
T-That's kinda like a dialect for me...
And overreacting is just a habit of mine, ya see.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I interrupted the party as well.
I am doubly sorry..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's all stuff you can easily reheat.
Why don't you have some too, Oguri-san?"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No, I can't do that.
You made it for your Trainer, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm not so starved that I'd go around
consuming other people's feelings.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: (Grrrrr...)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't have one on me,
but would you mind ordering something for me?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —Thank you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ayaa~...
You sure love your food, don't you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
People tell me that a lot,
but I don't really get it myself...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's always been this way,
ever since my days in Kasamatsu.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Kasamatsu... That's Oguri-san's hometown, right?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yukino, you came from Morioka, right?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
You already know about it?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
I've been hearing that name a lot lately.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Looks like you're working hard.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hawaah!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I got praised... by THE Oguri-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama scolds me. That's how I got to know you.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
Um...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Apparently, it's because I'm always spaced out and don't pay much attention to my surroundings.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Look out for the junior who followed in your footsteps...
is that it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I see. There really are a lot of them, huh.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I just don't understand
what you mean by 'following behind.'”

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Neither I nor anyone else
can ever be someone other than ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Everyone is running their own path, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Still, Tama told me to,
so I made sure to look at what was around me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "That's how I learned of your success. Coming from so far away, capturing everyone's hearts."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You're really loved
so very much, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Very much so!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Let's keep doing our best
for all the people cheering us on."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Haaah... Oguri-san is just so cool after all.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Still, I'm really happy... that you know what I'm doing right now.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'm gonna become a strong Umamusume who won't lose to Oguri-san either~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, ah!
The cooking!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I'll go heat this up real quick,
so I'm heading to the kitchen!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... In that case,
please!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, it reminds me of how
Ma and Pa used to bicker.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Mom used to scold me, saying,
"Don't go acting all high and mighty just for microwaving food!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah!?
I didn't mean it like that...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wah, please don't be down in the dumps~~!
All ya gotta do is heat it up~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah, were you teasing me!?

And so, Christmas night
passed in a lively fashion—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I've warmed up the food,
so let's eat right away.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
While you were seeing Oguri-san off, Trainer,
I got everything ready in a jiffy!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ahem!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "It's not like I've been slacking off these past three years either!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It just means I've grown a whole bunch, see!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Or so I think, at least.
What do you think...?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
There are still times when I don't feel confident
unless someone gives me a push on the back...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"May I count on you...
moving forward as well?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thank ye kindly!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A'ight, let's keep the party
going, shall we!

And so, a delightful Christmas
passed by.
